title: Hestia: Multimodal Food Chemistry & Evidence-Grounded Culinary Safety Assistant
description: An evidence-grounded culinary safety and food chemistry assistant that prevents LLM hallucinations by coupling multimodal ingredient vision with hierarchical multi-agent orchestration and canonical scientific databases (FooDB, EFSA OpenFoodTox, PubChem).
details: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Architecture: Engineered a 3-tier specialist agent system with Google ADK and LiteLLM (Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite & Qwen 3.6 35B), comprising Root Orchestrator, Food Analysis Specialist, and Research Specialist.

Evidence-Grounded Hallucination Prevention: Enforced strict Tool Budgeting (maximum 4 tool calls per analysis turn) and auditable FooDB citation tags ([<Compound:FDBxxxxxx>]), guaranteeing no fabricated chemical reactions without empirical evidence.

High-Performance Knowledge Engineering & Entity Resolution: Ingested over 70,000+ food-chemical relations from FooDB and EFSA OpenFoodTox 3.0 into SQLite; developed conservative fuzzy entity matching (SequenceMatcher + token subset containment with safety margins) mapping informal ingredient names to scientific taxonomy.
Real-Time Streaming Engine: Built a low-latency Server-Sent Events (SSE) pipeline via FastAPI delivering text_delta, tool_call, and tool_result events with sub-500ms Time-to-First-Token (TTFT).

Interactive Data & Reaction Pathway Visualization: Developed a responsive Next.js 16 (React 19, TypeScript) interface dynamically rendering Mermaid.js hazard pathway diagrams, KaTeX biochemical formulas, and bilingual i18n support (EN/VI).
highlights: Hierarchical 3-Tier Multi-Agent System via Google ADK
70,000+ Chemical Relations Indexed from FooDB & EFSA OpenFoodTox
Conservative Fuzzy Entity Resolution for Scientific Taxonomy
Real-Time SSE Streaming with Dynamic Mermaid.js Reaction Pathways
